summary: Enbridge Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the shareholder vote at its 2026 annual meeting to amend and reconfirm its existing shareholder rights plan (poison pill). The plan, originally effective 1995, requires triennial shareholder approval. The amendments extend the next approval to the 2029 annual meeting and include non-material changes. The plan triggers when a party acquires or announces intent to acquire 20% or more of common shares without board approval, entitling other holders to purchase shares at a 50% discount. This is a routine governance renewal, not a special situation. No deal, activist campaign, or strategic event is present.
